2: What our fearless staff seen?\nIt's the Homie Search Party!
3: The Variety Channel, a treasure\ntrove of laughs and tears!
4:
At the end of the day, our search
party came up empty.
They had to leave the deep dark
Union Cave. They also lost Gary.
“If only we had Flashbang!” the leader
cried. Gary is still in there.
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion, “The Cave That Went Black”!
5:
At the end of the day, our search
party came up empty.
We couldn't find no UNOWN...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“Solvin' the UNOWN Puzzle!”
6:
The search-party leader looked up at
the Johto sky and yelled a promise.
“We ain't failin' again!”
It mixed with the sad cries of the
SLOWPOKE that echoed nonstop...
Yawn... Yaaawn...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special, “The
Dark Shadow that Snatched SLOWPOKE!”
7:
The forest was dark and gloomy. We could
hear leaves crunchin' under
our feet.
“Leader, this a dead end!”
“Don't trip, let's go back.”
“Where the exit at?”
“Come on, we got this!”
“Let's just go back already...”
“You grown, ain't you? Quit cryin'!”
“Leader, your back...”
“What?!”
“On your back, a Bug-type homie...”
“Eeeeek!”
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“Big Brain Moves in Ilex Forest!”
8:
The leader of the search party looked
out at the Lake of Rage, mumblin'
“Ain't no rain that don't stop.”
He held his snapped Fishin' Rod and
headed back. The GYARADOS laughed.
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“Look! A Red Gyarados!”
9:
The inside of the cave was covered in
thick ice, just like a freezer.
“Aaaahchoooo!”
The search party was shiverin'
in the cold, and huddled around the
fiery PONYTA to stay warm.
They beat the cold...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“The Shiverin' Path Outta Ice!”
10:
The sailin' search party tried to
figure out the puzzle, but
their thoughts got interrupted and
washed away by the sound of the waves
around the Whirl Islands.
The shadow of a HUGE homie shifted and
shook in the violent sea full of
whirlpools...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special, “The
Legend That Vanished in the Whirlpool!”
11:
The forest was brighter than they
thought it'd be.
And they saw SO many Hustlers there.
“Ayo, a Bug Catcher!”
“What?”
“He wanna scrap us!”
“Then take the challenge!”
“But we ain't got no homies...”
“Dummy!”
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“The Viridian Forest Search Party!”
12:
We heard there was homies here,
but we ain't seen none yet.
We came all the way to Mt. Moon,
as a search party lookin' for homies.
We been waitin', spendin' time here,
and still the day we see a homie
ain't came yet...
When we gon' see one? What kinda
homie gon' come to Mt. Moon?
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“Rumors on Mt. Moon!”
13:
The members of the Homie Search
Party ridin' their Bicycles on
Route 17 and singin'.
Lookin' at their faces, they seem to be
chillin' and cyclin' along
however they want.
But they actually doin' this to look
for the homies along the route.
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“Illusion Cyclin'!”
14:
The search party got LOST!
In this weird world, up turned into
down, and left turned into right!
Then suddenly, right in front of the
confused search party, it appears!
GIRATINA!
There's SO few stories of anybody ever
meetin' this homie. It rarely shows.
But comparin' GIRATINA to the few
records out there, it look
different...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“The Weird GIRATINA!”
15:
The search party went on a long
trip out to the Sinnoh region.
The giant Mt. Coronet, risin' up to the
sky from the middle of Sinnoh...
Inside Mt. Coronet stretch a whole
maze of caverns...
Some members of the search party
struggled through the caverns,
only to end up at a
broken bridge.
They thought they found ancient ruins.
There was a weird feelin' in the air...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“Found it! The Illusion Space!”
16:
The search party had just about
hit the limit of its physical
strength, when it came to Cerulean
City to rest.
“Look, such a beautiful sunset...”
“Leader! Look over there!”
The member was pointin' at a
suspicious-lookin' cave!
The search party went to explore, and
found a weird flickerin' shadow...
Tune in next time for the crazy
conclusion of the special,
“The True Shape of the Cave's Owner!”
